Name: Not so Simple MO2 Icons
Author: Vyger1
Description:
[A note regarding permissions: Almost any part of this mod has been created from scratch by myself using the base Mod Organizer 2 Icon and don't use any assets from another mod. The only other assets are the "fancy" part of the Icons for Morrowind, Oblivion and Skyrim respectively which come from awakemon on Reddit and I have received their permissions to use those assets to make my mod. While my Icons are based on and inspired by Loukeyos work, none of my Icons actually use any of their assets. I have asked Nexus support if that would suffice for me to open my permissions and they agreed. If you have any questions or disagreements about this, please message me and ask without nuking my mod beforehand. Thank you :) ]




I have been using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/starfield/mods/4221]Loukeyo's Simple MO2 Icons[/url] for quite a while and I love them, but then stumbled over these [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/Morrowind/comments/1af11vz/mo2_icons_for_morrowind_oblivion_skyrim/]beautiful icons from awakemon over on Reddit[/url]﻿ and fell in love as well.

So I combined them... as well as added a few more.

The available Icons are for:

    Baldur's Gate 3
    Cyberpunk 2077
    Fallout 4
    Fallout London
    Fallout New Vegas
    Morrowind 
    Nier Automata
    Oblivion
    Skyrim
    Stardew Valley
    Starfield


I hope you like them, and please feel free to leave Feedback :)
